visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette of the largest sea turtle ever documented, reaching over 4 meters in width.
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: DUSK_SILHOUETTE; intense backlighting to emphasize the 'star-shaped' skeletal frame of the leathery shell.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: A large, distinct bird-like hooked beak and a relatively short, thick neck.

pose: Top-down view with the massive, paddle-like front flippers fully extended to maximize the width of the silhouette and highlight the pointed tip of the tail.
negative_constraints: No internal shell detail; the silhouette must show the slight 'notches' along the edge of the carapace where the ribs meet the leather.
